title: Mesa Police Officers Shoot Man Who Pointed a BB Gun at Them
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Mesa, Arizona — On September 18th, 2025, just after midnight, a female caller reported that her husband was drunk and throwing things around the house. While giving information, the caller said that the man was going to and from his vehicle and had a gun. Officers responded to the 900 block of South Pasadena. As an officer was arriving on scene, a sergeant who was also arriving said over the radio that he had just seen the carport lights turn on, but did not see anyone outside. The officer and the sergeant begin to walk up to the house. When the 33-year-old suspect exited the house using the carport door, he immediately points a gun at the officer and sergeant. This is when the officer involved shooting occurred. Additional officers arrived on scene and rendered aid to the suspect before he was transported to a hospital for his injuries. No officers or bystanders were injured because of the shooting. The gun that the suspect had, was later determined to be a Glock replica BB gun.
